adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies legacy SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts lines directly into the new embeddable_hosts.host column via raw SQL: `execute "... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. This bypasses EmbeddableHost's `before_validation` normalization (stripping `http(s)://` and paths) in app/models/embeddable_host.rb, so legacy entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly present in updated specs) would be stored with scheme/path and then fail matching in `record_for_host`, which compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. Additionally, interpolating `h` into SQL unescaped can break the migration if `h` contains a single quote and is generally unsafe.
